Abgerufen am: 21.09.2026 07:33

About us
Havelstrom Payments is a licensed payment institution processing card and account-to-account payments for more than 40,000 merchants across Europe. We are 520 people from 38 nations, headquartered in Berlin with hubs in Lisbon and Warsaw.

The role
As Head of Information Security Programmes you report directly to our CISO and own the delivery of our multi-year security roadmap. You turn regulatory requirements and threat insights into a prioritised portfolio of programmes and make sure they land on time and within budget.

What you will do
Lead the security programme portfolio (approx. EUR 12m per year), including the renewal of identity and access management, the transition of our SOC to a managed provider and the rollout of zero trust networking
Translate DORA and PCI DSS 4.0 requirements into deliverable projects and keep the evidence ready for regulators and auditors
Build and lead a team of five security project managers
Report status, risks and KPIs to the executive board and the risk committee of the supervisory board
Work closely with Engineering, Compliance and Internal Audit

What you bring
10+ years in IT or information security, at least 5 of them leading programmes or large projects
Proven delivery of security programmes in a regulated environment (banking, payments or insurance)
Solid understanding of ISO 27001, NIST CSF and cloud security on AWS
A certification such as CISSP, CISM or PMP is a plus
Excellent English; German is a plus but not required

What we offer
Permanent full-time contract
Base salary EUR 125,000 to 145,000 plus annual bonus
Hybrid work with 2 days per week in our Berlin office
30 days of vacation and a personal learning budget of EUR 2,000

Seniority level
Director

Employment type
Full-time

Job function
Information Technology

Industries
Financial Services
